_description: Registry of Colorado FSA STC meetings the site knows about. Each entry maps a meeting date to its index JSON (if parsed) plus lightweight metadata for the /board-meetings index. Add new meetings here when project delivers parsed data.

meetings.title: STC Meeting — August 27, 2026
meetings.location: Denver Federal Center (Lakewood, CO) OR Virtual via Teams
meetings.note: 925-page exec packet (parsed). Highlights: Beeutiful Things ELAP appeal (Elbert, 90 min), Kit Carson Cure LFP series (6 apps × 2020/2021, attorney Byrd involved), STC-member SDRP items 7.a.3 & 7.a.4 (McConnell recuse), Schroder CRP cost-share (returning from July 23 tabled), 13-county Safflower ARC/PLC yields, $9M EFRP request across 9 mountain pine beetle counties.

meetings.title: STC Meeting — July 23, 2026
meetings.note: MINUTES APPROVED. Exec: 2 ECPs approved (Rio Blanco Carter + Lopez), Las Animas Beans PNT De Ir new-crop approved. TABLED: Schroder CRP cost-share, all 10 2027 NCT crops (returning Aug 27). Regular: 2025 ARC-CO county yields APPROVED for corn/flaxseed/sorghum/peanuts/soybeans/sunflower — Mackey/Petrocco motion passed.

meetings.title: STC Meeting — June 24, 2026
meetings.location: Denver Federal Center (Lakewood, CO) + Virtual via Teams
meetings.note: PARSED FROM MINUTES. Exec: Peppers/cantaloupe NAP NOL denial UPHELD from Feb 11 (drought Dec 2024 through Jun 2025) — Raftopoulos/Petrocco unanimous. Daniel Selzer La Plata equitable relief on late-file 2026 CCC-471 GRANTED. 2027 NCT approvals: Asparagus (Direct Market Price $143.29 for 2026-27), Caneberries, Canola, others. Regular: RMA T-yield changes for wheat 2027 concurred (Consultation 202608R0151).

meetings.title: STC Meeting — May 28, 2026
meetings.note: PARSED FROM MINUTES. Exec: Alamosa/Costilla CRP Signup 206 equitable relief for Oklahoma Judicial Process Servers LLC (misaction/misinformation, effective 10/01/2024) recommended to DAFP. CRP component added at $125/foot Not-to-Exceed rate. 2026 NCT approvals (Cucumbers). New crops: San Miguel Triticale Ni for Fg, Dolores Mixfg LGG Fg Ir. Regular: 2025 ARC-CO yields APPROVED for Barley, Chickpeas Large, Canola, Dry Peas, Oats, Wheat — Petrocco/McConnell motion passed.

meetings.title: STC Meeting — April 23, 2026
meetings.note: 4 appeals heard. STC recorded outcomes on Appeals 3 (Proctor) and 4 (River Edge Dairy) — both COC denials AFFIRMED. Ebright (Appeal 1) status pending — check /appeals for detail. 3R Lamb (Appeal 2) case file was password-protected. See /appeals for full case analysis.

meetings.title: STC Meeting — March 24, 2026
meetings.location: Denver Federal Center (Lakewood, CO) — first in-person
meetings.note: PARSED FROM MINUTES. Regular: Otero/Crowley COC authorities DELEGATED to Dara Belew (CED). 2026 SDA advisors approved. STC policies + delegations of authority for all counties adopted (ARC/PLC, ERP, FSFL). 2025 grass/improved-grass losses approved (irrigated + non-irrigated). Exec: Feb 11 disapprovals of NAP Prevented-Planting NOLs REAFFIRMED. Otero producers Day, Bender, others — CCC-576 Part B claims OVERTURNED and disapproved. 2026 NCT continues (Beets et al). Ebright CRP appeal continued to April 23.

meetings.title: STC Special Session — February 11, 2026
meetings.note: Follow-up executive session immediately after Feb 10 meeting. Additional NAP prevent-plant NOL determinations (context reaffirmed at March 24).

meetings.title: STC Meeting — February 10, 2026
meetings.note: PARSED FROM MINUTES. Exec: Valley View Ranch LLC equitable relief on 2021 ECP Cost Share Request APPROVED ($3,850). ECP-1 par 179B Cost Share Review requested from ECP-Program Manager for EC3 Barbed/Smooth Wire Difficult Terrain Multi-Strand Replace — DAFP rate suggestion approved. 2026 NCT approvals: Millet, Oats, Peppers, Pumpkins (among others). Regular: 2025 grass/improved-grass losses approved (irrigated + non-irrigated). 2019-2023 ARC-CO missing yields APPROVED for 12 crops: barley, chickpeas, canola, dry peas, flaxseed, grain sorghum, oats, peanuts, safflower, soybeans, sunflower seed, wheat.
